issues.detail: The Greek 'βαπτισμους ποτηριων και ξεστων και χαλκιων και κλινων' means 'washings of cups and pitchers and copper vessels and couches' — the Vietnamese renders 'ξεστων' (pitchers/jugs) as 'cái chén' (cups), which duplicates 'ποτηριων' (cups) and omits the distinct category of pitchers. This changes the list of items being washed.
